name: repo-cover
description: Turn repository evidence into editable, project-specific GitHub Social Preview images.

interface.shortDescription: Design social previews from real repository evidence.
interface.longDescription: RepoCover reads a local or remote repository before composing an editable 1280×640 GitHub Social Preview. It preserves useful screenshots and project artwork, infers a truthful visual direction when no suitable image exists, and validates the final SVG and PNG.
defaultPrompt: Read this repository and create a validated GitHub Social Preview.
Improve this repository's existing social preview without losing its identity.
Create a repository cover even though this project has no hero image.
